answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 13277 Country: Pakistan Title: janb mufti sahib, assalamualikoom warahmatullah. i have to ask you 2 questions. (1)my daughter`s name is "RIBQAH" and in arabic "ربقه" tell me please that, is at a true name? is there any problem? (2)is there any difference between the name "محمود حسن" and the name of "محمود الحسن" please answer me soon. jazakallah. mahmood hasan. from karachi pakistan Question: janb mufti sahib, assalamualikoom warahmatullah. i have to ask you 2 questions. (1)my daughter`s name is "RIBQAH" and in arabic "ربقه" tell me please that, is at a true name? is there any problem? (2)is there any difference between the name "محمود حسن" and the name of "محمود الحسن" please answer me soon. jazakallah. mahmood hasan. from karachi pakistan Answer ID: 13277 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 818/634=L/1430) Ribqah means noose. This is not a good name, instead you should keep names like Maryam, Ayishah, Hafsah, Juwairiyah, Zainab, Fatimah, Saudah etc. (2) No, there is no difference. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
